digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI (+ Mgombato bebena)

teaser.en: A wild grapevine with a 'chewable' stem, as its Digo name says.
teaser.sw: Mzabibu pori wenye shina 'linalotafunika', kama jina lake la Kidigo linavyosema.
teaser.dg: Mzabibu wa weruni wenye muhi 'unaobebeneka', dza dzinare ra Chidigo rinavyogomba.

summary.en: Mbebeneka is a wild grapevine that climbs by tendrils and bears bunches of small dark berries. Its name means 'chewable', after its stem.
summary.sw: Mbebeneka ni mzabibu pori unaopanda kwa vitete-shikizi na kuzaa vishada vya matunda madogo meusi. Jina lake maana yake 'linalotafunika', kutokana na shina lake.
summary.dg: *Mbebeneka* ni mzabibu wa weruni unaokpwera kpwa nyuzi zinazodzizunguluka, na unalavya makundi ga matunda madide ga rangi nzito. Dzinare rina mana ya 'unaobebeneka', kpwa sababu ya muhiwe.

about.en: Mbebeneka is a climber of the grape family. It grows from a woody rootstock and climbs by tendrils, which grow opposite the leaves. The leaves are large and lobed, like grape leaves, and are often covered with rusty hairs underneath. Small reddish flowers in branched clusters are followed by bunches of round berries that turn dark purple-black when ripe, much like small grapes.
about.sw: Mbebeneka ni mtambaa wa familia ya mizabibu. Huota kutoka shina-mzizi gumu kama mti na hupanda kwa vitete-shikizi, vinavyoota mkabala na majani. Majani ni makubwa na yenye mapande, kama majani ya mzabibu, na mara nyingi yamefunikwa kwa manyoya ya rangi ya kutu upande wa chini. Maua madogo mekundu katika vishada vyenye matawi hufuatwa na vishada vya matunda ya mviringo yanayogeuka zambarau-nyeusi yakikomaa, kama zabibu ndogo.
about.dg: *Mbebeneka* ni mmea wa kukpwera wa jamii ya mzabibu. Unamera kula muzi mgumu dza wa muhi, na unakpwera kpwa nyuzi zinazodzizunguluka, zinazomera zichilolana na makodza. Makodza ni makulu na gana mala, dza makodza ga mzabibu, na mara nyinji photsi gana nyere ndide za rangi ya dongo. Maruwa madide ga kundu chidide ganamera kpwa makundi genye panda, na badaye kunazuka makundi ga matunda ga mviringo, ganayokala ga zambarau nzito na maru ganaphoivwa, dza zabibu ndide.

where.en: It climbs over shrubs and small trees in bush, thicket and at forest edges, and is common in coastal bushland.
where.sw: Hupanda juu ya vichaka na miti midogo vichakani, katika vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu, na hupatikana sana katika vichaka vya pwani.
where.dg: Unakpwera dzulu ya vitsaka na mihi midide weruni, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, na ni wa kawaida weruni wa pwani.

uses.en: Pakia records no use apart from what the name suggests. Elsewhere in East and southern Africa the ripe berries are eaten as a sour wild fruit.
uses.sw: Pakia haripoti matumizi yoyote isipokuwa yale ambayo jina linadokeza. Kwingineko Afrika Mashariki na Kusini, matunda yaliyokomaa huliwa kama tunda la porini lenye uchachu.
uses.dg: Kahi ya matumizi, Pakia anaandika tu higo ganagoonyeswa ni dzinare. Kpwenye seemu zanjina za Afrika ya Mashariki na ya kusini, matunda gachiivwa nkuriwa dza matunda ga weruni ga ngbwadu.

culture.en: The name records an everyday experience of the plant. Pakia explains *mbebeneka* as 'chewable': the stem can be chewed (*bebeneka*). Mgombato has the related verb *bebena*, 'to chew, to crunch'.
culture.sw: Jina hili linahifadhi uzoefu wa kila siku wa mmea huu. Pakia anaeleza *mbebeneka* kama 'linalotafunika': shina linaweza kutafunwa (*bebeneka*). Mgombato ina kitenzi kinachohusiana, *bebena*, 'kutafuna, kuchakacha'.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri rinaonyesa dzambo ra chila siku ra mmea uhu. Pakia anagomba kukala *mbebeneka* rina mana ya 'unaobebeneka': muhiwe unaweza kubebenwa (*bebeneka*). Mgombato ina neno *bebena*, renye mana ya kuafuna kpwa sauti (*to chew, to crunch*).

names.en: Digo: *mbebeneka*, 'chewable'. Pakia records it only for Digo, and no Swahili name is recorded. In English, *Ampelocissus* species are often called wild grapes.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbebeneka*, 'linalotafunika'. Pakia anaurekodi kwa Kidigo tu, na hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Kwa Kiingereza, spishi za *Ampelocissus* mara nyingi huitwa *wild grapes*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mbebeneka*, 'unaobebeneka'. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, na takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Kpwa Chingereza, aina za *Ampelocissus* mara nyinji nkuihwa *wild grapes*.

reason.en: Cissus, another climber of the grape family
reason.sw: Cissus, mtambaa mwingine wa familia ya mizabibu
reason.dg: *Mdokadoka* (*Cissus*), mmea wanjina wa kukpwera wa jamii ya mzabibu

reason.sw: Cyphostemma, mmea mwingine wa familia ya mizabibu
reason.dg: *Mgongolo mlume* (*Cyphostemma*), mmea wanjina wa jamii ya mzabibu

mgombato: bebena to chew, to crunch; kutafuna kwa kishindo, kuchakacha menoni. (See: afuna)
